# whatmodel.sh · find the best image models you can run

[llm](../README.md) · **image** · [video](video.md) · [tts](tts.md) · [stt](stt.md)

updated 2026-09-26 03:10 UTC · 87 models · scores combine 19 benchmarks · [how it works](method.md) · [benchmark your machine](https://whatmodel.sh/bench) · [interactive version](https://whatmodel.sh/image)

These studies cover separate model sets. Scores compare models within the selected set only: **LMArena text-to-image · 122 models** · [CVTG-2K word accuracy · 3 models](https://whatmodel.sh/image?set=cvtg-2k-word-accuracy%40visual-mage-flow)

## For your machine

This list shows every model with a way to run it. To see what fits your machine, run the command for your OS, or pick one of the common machines below on the site.

```sh
curl "whatmodel.sh/image?mac=$(sysctl -n hw.memsize)"   # Mac
curl "whatmodel.sh/image?ram=$(awk '/MemT/{print $2}' /proc/meminfo)&vram=$(nvidia-smi -i 0 --query-gpu=memory.total --format=csv,noheader,nounits 2>/dev/null || cat /sys/class/drm/card*/device/mem_info_vram_total 2>/dev/null | sort -n | tail -1)"   # Linux
curl.exe "whatmodel.sh/image?ram=$((gcim Win32_ComputerSystem).TotalPhysicalMemory)&vram=$(nvidia-smi -i 0 --query-gpu=memory.total --format=csv,noheader,nounits 2>$null)"   # Windows
```

[16GB Mac](https://whatmodel.sh/image?ram=16&gpu=apple) · [32GB Mac](https://whatmodel.sh/image?ram=32&gpu=apple) · [64GB Mac](https://whatmodel.sh/image?ram=64&gpu=apple) · [128GB Mac](https://whatmodel.sh/image?ram=128&gpu=apple) · [12GB graphics card](https://whatmodel.sh/image?ram=32&gpu=card&vram=12) · [24GB graphics card](https://whatmodel.sh/image?ram=64&gpu=card&vram=24) · [16GB, no graphics card](https://whatmodel.sh/image?ram=16&gpu=none)

Run `curl whatmodel.sh/image` to get this list in your terminal (add `?format=json` for agents).
